limitations: No published L1 photoreceptor current, half-saturation, adaptation time constant, or Rh5/Rh6 gain is supplied by the connectome source.
The Rh5 ambient-weighted and Rh6 temporal-weighted responses are an explicit hypothesis, not measured L1 physiology.
Only the two bilateral Bolwig-organ samples are used; no direct dorsal-versus-ventral visual receptor pair is invented.
Published neurotransmitter identity does not by itself establish the postsynaptic physiological sign in this circuit.
Serotonergic, octopaminergic/tyraminergic, and Pdf-LaN output contacts remain structural-only because the reduced LIF core has no justified modulatory dynamics.
A single fitted current per observed contact does not imply measured synaptic conductance or release probability.

lateral_mapping_evidence.use: response-direction prior only; no numeric value or L1 connection is copied

limitations: The Larderet matrix ends at visual projection neurons and does not identify their path to VNC premotor neurons.
The bridge is a declared fitted causal proxy and is not described as a monosynaptic VPN-to-A27h connection.
The crossed lateral mapping uses L2 light-avoidance direction as a response prior only; it is not an identified L1 descending edge.
The left/right activity gains compensate specimen-specific matrix asymmetry for the diagnostic fixture and are not measured hemispheric gains.
Dorsal and ventral bridge currents receive the same common visual drive; vertical steering cannot be attributed to a fabricated dorsal-versus-ventral Bolwig-organ comparison.

parameter_provenance.objective: Exercise the published bilateral L1 LON topology in a stable, nonsaturated causal loop and produce opposite-signed, near-balanced steering under mirrored lateral light fields while retaining the published specimen asymmetry.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: All phototransduction values, LIF contact current, assumed synaptic effects, readout filtering, and the visual-to-premotor bridge are calibration parameters rather than measured L1 constants.

limitations: This is a connectome-driven LON-to-body research approximation, not validated natural L1 phototaxis.
The source matrix contains no identified beyond-LON descending targets or visual-to-VNC premotor path.
The validation light field and virtual bilateral sample locations are model fixtures, not reconstructed natural illumination or measured Bolwig-organ coordinates.
The executed topology contains no action command, target selector, finite-state machine, behavior tree, or policy network.
